notes.title: Watch the Devs, Voice Actors and Community Stream The Expanse: A Telltale Series
notes.content:
Katy Bentz, Eriawave and Abravacado (The Voice Actor for Maya) Stream The Expanse: A Telltale Series and discuss fun facts about making the game.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/katybentz]Katy [/url] is an voice actor, who plays Steph Gingrich in Life is Strange. She's also one of the hosts of Behind the Belt, a deep dive stream with the developers of The Expanse: A Telltale Series. 

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/eirawave]Eirawave[/url] is a Creative Designer working on The Expanse: A Telltale Series. They're a big fan of the TV show and internationally recognised for their fantastic work. They also stream regularly both their art & games on twitch

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/abravacado]Abravacado[/url] is a voice actor and streamer. She voices the character Maya in the game, and streams story games on Twitch every week.

notes.title: NOMINATE THE EXPANSE: A TELLTALE SERIES IN THE STEAM AWARDS!
notes.content:
Oya Beltalowda!

Whether you played The Expanse: A Telltale Series on PlayStation, Xbox, Epic Games Store or are picking it up for the very first time on Steam, thank you from everyone at Telltale and Deck Nine.

If you’ve enjoyed the game, please consider voting for us for the Outstanding Story-Rich Game in this year’s Steam Awards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44738406/6ccdb3c6bc515e865aff6fa28801e579055a6130.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone for supporting Telltale’s return this year!

- Telltale & Deck Nine
